question: Please tell me the ranking for how good a friend Otto is with the people in the Emilia camp.
answer: Subaru > Garfiel > Frederica > Petra > Emilia > Beatrice > Ram >>>>> Roswaal, maybe.  Having said that, he’s on good terms with everyone except Roswaal, so the Emilia camp is stable, you know.  Except for Roswaal.
